name: AMBR Experiments
description: Methodology and human-performance benchmark results intended as a baseline evaluation for driving-related tasks.
evaluation_method: human_eval / task_success_rate (behavioral baseline comparisons to human drivers)
reputation: A niche academic human-performance baseline used in autonomous driving research; referenced for human comparison but not a broad industry standard.
notes: Human-performance baseline rather than an automated-model-only benchmark; small-scale and task-specific results can be context-dependent; not designed for LLM evaluation; potential variability across driving scenarios.
